The '''Curse of Sycorax''' was an old [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolitan]] legend about the [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Sycorax]]. After the Necropolitans killed her son, Sycorax cursed the world and warned of the consequences of disturbing the [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Many natives believed that thanks to this curse, dead people who were not respected would rise as [[zombie]]s, which were occasionally seen to walk on Necropolis.

This legend led [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] to visit the world, discover that the fluids of native [[boneworm]]s could reanimate the recently killed, and develop a formula with similar effects. His assistant [[Pylum]] was found dead with no obvious cause at a key moment, allowing him and his zombies to be stopped. [[Mammon Hoole]] wondered if it was the curse's doing.
